landing.lead: Manage guests, RSVP responses, WhatsApp invitations, tables, seating and event analytics in one place.
landing.note: No account required. Explore fully populated demo events.

guests.title: Guest Management
guests.body: Keep all your guests in one place, with search, filters and import from a spreadsheet.

rsvp.title: RSVP Tracking
rsvp.body: One RSVP link per event. See who is coming, who is not sure and who declined.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Invitations
whatsapp.body: Write your invitation once and open it in WhatsApp for each guest, ready to send.

seating.title: Seating & Tables
seating.body: Set up your tables and assign confirmed guests, with capacity checked for you.

band.title: Explore the demo — no setup required.
band.body: Discover every feature with fully populated events and fictional sample data.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to manage your events.

events.subtitle: Manage your events, guests, and RSVPs all in one place.
